mapper.select: SELECT u.user_sq, u.user_nm, u.user_email, u.user_type_cd, u.user_signup_type_cd FROM tbl_user_social_account usa JOIN tbl_user_m u ON usa.user_sq = u.user_sq WHERE usa.social_id = #{socialId} AND usa.social_provider_cd = #{providerCd} AND u.user_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_user_m ( user_email, user_nm, user_id, user_phone_num, user_type_cd, user_signup_type_cd, user_agreed_privacy_policy_yn, user_is_deleted_yn, user_created_at_dtm ) VALUES ( #{userEmail}, #{userNm}, #{userId}, #{userPhoneNum}, #{userTypeCd}, #{userSignupTypeCd}, 'Y', 'N', NOW() )

INSERT INTO tbl_user_social_account ( user_sq, social_provider_cd, social_id, social_email, social_refresh_token, social_token_expired_at_dtm, social_created_at_dtm ) VALUES ( #{userSq}, #{socialProviderCd}, #{socialId}, #{socialEmail}, #{socialRefreshToken}, #{socialTokenExpiredAtDtm}, NOW() )
